Distilled tokens

The frame's own color/radius/type values, compared against this project's design-system/tokens.json. Roles line up closely with the existing semantic tokens; several exact values drift — each drift has a matching open question below.

#151212 — dark surface Header / hero / footer bg, "Add to Order" button fill. No matching token exists — closest is color-fg (#2a1b12), which is a text color, not a surface.
#C82D25 — primary red CTAs, logo badge, nav underline, icon badges. color-primary token is #b3261e — visibly different shade.
#2A7043 — secondary green Delivery banner bg, "30 mins" ETA highlight. color-secondary token is #4b7f52 — darker/more saturated here.
#6B6661 — muted text Close match to color-fg-muted (#6b5a4e).
#EBE7DF — card border Close match to color-border (#e4d6c3).
#FCFAF6 — page bg Near-identical to color-bg (#fbf6ef).

Radii: 8px and 16px match radius-md / radius-lg exactly (buttons, cards, story images). 18px, 20px (circular icon badges) and 24px (hero image corner) have no exact token — see radius-scale-gaps. Heading font (Fraunces) matches font-family-heading exactly; body font is Geist in Figma vs. Inter in font-family-body (same sans-serif role).
